Chemistry Unknown-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry Unknown-I.question: The chemical properties of an element depend upon
options: the number of isotopes of the element
the mass number of the element
the total number of neutrons in the element
the number of electrons in the outermost shell of the element
Chemistry Unknown-I.answer: the number of electrons in the outermost shell of the element
Chemistry Unknown-I.explanation: (d)  The period of an element in the periodic table depends on the total number of electron shells in the atom of that element. Chemical property of an element depends on the valence electrons which participate in bond formation. Isotopes are two or more forms of the same element with equal numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons. Total number of  protons  and neutrons is mass number. Chemical property is independent of neutrons and protons.

Chemistry Unknown-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry Unknown-I.question: How many hydrogen atoms are contained in 1.50 g of glucose (C6H12O6)?
Chemistry Unknown-I.explanation: (d) There are 12 atoms of hydrogen per molecule of glucose, which has a molar mass of 180g/mol. Hence the number of moles of hydrogen = 12 × 1.50 ÷ 180 = 0.10mol. Hence the number of hydrogen atoms is found by multiplying this by the Avogadro Constant, 6.02 × 10²³. This gives you 6.02 × 10²² atoms.
